question_used: What are the major products and services that AMD sells as of FY22?
gold_answer: AMD sells server microprocessors (CPUs) and graphics processing units (GPUs), data processing units (DPUs), Field Programmable Gate Arrays (FPGAs), and Adaptive System-on-Chip (SoC) products for data centers; CPUs, accelerated processing units (APUs) that integrate CPUs and GPUs, and chipsets for desktop and notebook personal computers; discrete GPUs, and semi-custom SoC products and development services; and embedded CPUs, GPUs, APUs, FPGAs, and Adaptive SoC products.
answer: As of FY22 (fiscal year ended December 31, 2022), AMD's major products and services, organized by its four reportable segments, were: (1) Data Center segment — server microprocessors (EPYC CPUs), data center GPUs (Instinct accelerators for AI/HPC), and adaptive/embedded compute products used in servers; (2) Client segment — Ryzen desktop and notebook microprocessors/APUs, and chipsets for PCs; (3) Gaming segment — Radeon discrete graphics cards/GPUs for desktops and notebooks, and semi-custom SoC products (game console processors) sold to customers such as Microsoft (Xbox) and Sony (PlayStation); and (4) Embedded segment — embedded processors, FPGAs, and adaptive SoCs (largely from the Xilinx acquisition completed in February 2022), used in industrial, communications, automotive, and aerospace/defense applications. AMD also offers software, development tools, and solutions (e.g., ROCm software stack) supporting these hardware products.
